intro:
📌 Capaian Pembelajaran Fase D (ringkas)

sections.title: Read the text
paras:
Five Habits of Healthy Teenagers
Being a teenager is fun, but it is also busy. To stay healthy, you should build good habits.

First, eat a balanced diet. Your plate should have rice or other carbohydrates, vegetables, fruit, and protein such as eggs, fish, or tempeh. Second, drink at least eight glasses of water a day. Third, exercise for 30 minutes every day — walking, cycling, or playing sports.
Fourth, sleep well. Teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep. You shouldn't use your phone in bed. Finally, wash your hands with soap before eating.
Start with one habit today, and your body will thank you!

sections.title: Remember
Recount text
paras:
Camping at Ranu Kumbolo
Last school holiday, my scout group and I went camping at Ranu Kumbolo, a beautiful lake on the slope of Mount Semeru. It was my first camping trip.

On the first day, we left Malang early in the morning. We hiked for about five hours. The path was steep and slippery, but the view was amazing. We arrived at the lake in the afternoon and set up our tents.
At night, it was very cold. We made a campfire, cooked instant noodles, and told funny stories. Before we slept, we saw thousands of stars in the sky.
The next morning, we watched the sunrise over the lake. Then we cleaned the area and took all our rubbish home. I was tired, but it was the best trip of my life. I will never forget it.

sections.html:
Orientation
Siapa, kapan, di mana: Last school holiday, my scout group and I went camping at Ranu Kumbolo…
Events
Rangkaian peristiwa sesuai urutan waktu: On the first day… At night… The next morning…
Reorientation
Kesan/penutup: I was tired, but it was the best trip of my life.

sections.title: Read the text
paras:
Indonesia's Record Breakers
Indonesia is the largest archipelago in the world. It has more than 17,000 islands. New Guinea, which we share with Papua New Guinea, is the second largest island on Earth, and Borneo, which we share with Malaysia and Brunei, is the third largest.
Puncak Jaya in Papua is the highest mountain in Indonesia. It is 4,884 metres high — higher than Mount Kerinci, the highest volcano in the country.
Lake Toba in North Sumatra is the largest lake in Indonesia and the largest volcanic lake in the world. It is much bigger than Lake Singkarak.
And the Komodo dragon? It is the biggest and heaviest lizard on the planet. A Komodo can be heavier than an adult man!

Which statement is true?|A Komodo is lighter than a cat.|Borneo is the largest island in the world.|A Komodo can be heavier than an adult man.

sections.title: Procedure text
paras:
How to Make a Simple Water Filter
Clean water is important. You can make a simple water filter at home for a science project.
Materials: a used plastic bottle (1.5 L), a cutter, clean cotton, fine sand, coarse sand, small gravel, charcoal, and dirty water.

Steps: First, cut the bottom of the bottle. Second, turn the bottle upside down and put the cotton in the neck. Then, add the layers in this order: charcoal, fine sand, coarse sand, and gravel. Next, pour the dirty water slowly into the filter. Finally, collect the water in a glass and compare it with the dirty water.
Note: The water is cleaner, but it is not safe to drink. Boil it first!

sections.title: Report text
paras:
The Orangutan
Orangutans are great apes. They live only in the rainforests of Sumatra and Borneo. The name “orangutan” comes from Malay and means “person of the forest”.
An adult male orangutan can weigh up to 90 kilograms. Orangutans have long arms, reddish-brown hair, and very strong hands. Their arms can be two metres wide from fingertip to fingertip.
Orangutans spend most of their lives in trees. Every night, they build a new nest of leaves to sleep in. They mostly eat fruit, but they also eat leaves, bark, and insects.
Sadly, orangutans are critically endangered because people cut down their forests. We can help them by saying no to products from illegal logging and by supporting conservation programs.

sections.html: Report text menjelaskan sesuatu secara umum (misalnya jenis hewan), berbeda dengan descriptive text yang menggambarkan satu hal tertentu (misalnya kucingku). Strukturnya: General classification → Description (ciri, habitat, makanan, perilaku). Kalimatnya memakai simple present dan kosakata ilmiah.
